data.narrative:
Nordic Air Defence, a seed-stage defense and security company founded by Karl Rosander, is evaluated against a comparable universe of 10 private peers and 2 public companies operating in the same sector. The peer set includes established seed and Series A-stage firms such as UFORCE, Stark Defence, Castelion, Singularity, and NODA AI, with public comparables tracked via DRSHF and IDEAFORGE.NS.

The peer-median method serves as the primary valuation triangulation approach given available data. The analysis examines five same-sector and same/adjacent-stage peers, which exhibit a wide valuation range from $125M (NODA AI) to $4.0B (Stark Defence). The median valuation across this five-company cohort is $1.0B, with UFORCE—a direct seed-stage comparable—valued at $1.0B, providing direct validation of the stage-appropriate benchmark.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $850M to $1.1B, centered on a median of $1.0B. Key uncertainties include the broad dispersion within the peer set ($125M to $4.0B), reflecting meaningful heterogeneity in company stage, technology maturity, and commercial traction within defense and security. The single-method approach and lack of disclosed fundraising data for Nordic Air Defence limit the robustness of this estimate. Additional validation via revenue multiples or customer concentration metrics would strengthen confidence in the valuation range.
